name.text: Finding the height of a building

questiontext.text:
A student stands {@distance@} metres from the base of a building. The angle of elevation from the student's position to the top of the building is {@theta@} degrees.

Use the information to calculate the height of the building.

[[jsxgraph height='400px' width='600px']] var theta = {#theta#}; var d = {#distance#}; var h = {#height#}; /* Initialise the JSXGraph board */ var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [-0.15*d, 1.25*h, 1.25*d, -0.2*h], axis: false, showCopyright: false, showNavigation: false, keepaspectratio: false }); /* Define the triangle vertices */ var P = board.create('point', [0,0], { name: 'P', fixed: true, size: 3, color: 'black' }); var Q = board.create('point', [d,0], { name: 'Q', fixed: true, size: 3, color: 'black' }); var R = board.create('point', [d,h], { name: 'R', fixed: true, size: 3, color: 'black' }); /* Horizontal ground */ board.create('segment', [P,Q], { strokeColor: 'black', strokeWidth: 3 }); /* Vertical building */ board.create('segment', [Q,R], { strokeColor: 'black', strokeWidth: 3 }); /* Line of sight */ board.create('segment', [P,R], { strokeColor: '#2563eb', strokeWidth: 3 }); /* Right-angle marker */ var s = Math.min(d,h)*0.06; board.create('segment', [[d-s,0],[d-s,s]], { strokeColor: 'black', strokeWidth: 1 }); board.create('segment', [[d-s,s],[d,s]], { strokeColor: 'black', strokeWidth: 1 }); /* Angle of elevation marker */ board.create('angle', [Q,P,R], { radius: Math.min(d,h)*0.18, name: '', withLabel: false, strokeColor: '#2563eb', strokeWidth: 2 }); /* Angle label */ board.create('text', [0.18*d,0.08*h,theta+'°'], { fixed: true, fontSize: 16, color: '#2563eb' }); /* Distance label */ board.create('text', [d/2,-0.10*h,'Distance = '+d+' m'], { fixed: true, fontSize: 13, anchorX: 'middle' }); /* Building height label */ board.create('text', [d+0.04*d,h/2,'Height = ?'], { fixed: true, fontSize: 13 }); /* Line of sight label */ board.create('text', [0.40*d,0.60*h,'Line of sight'], { fixed: true, fontSize: 13, color: '#2563eb' }); board.update(); [[/jsxgraph]]

Calculate the height of the building.

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

Instructions: Give your answer correct to 1 decimal place. Your answer should be expressed in metres.

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

We are given:

  • Angle of elevation: \({@theta@}^\circ\)
  • Horizontal distance: \({@distance@}\text{ m}\)

We need to calculate the height of the building.

Step 1: Identify the appropriate trigonometric ratio.

We know the adjacent side and need to find the opposite side. Therefore, we use tangent:

\(\tan\theta=\dfrac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}}\)

Step 2: Substitute the known values.

\(\tan({@theta@}^\circ)=\dfrac{h}{@distance@}\)

Step 3: Rearrange to make the height the subject.

\(h={@distance@}\times\tan({@theta@}^\circ)\)

Step 4: Calculate the height.

\(h\approx {@ta1@}\text{ m}\)

Final Answer:

\(\boxed{h={@ta1@}\text{ m}}\)

Remember to use degree mode on your calculator and round your answer to 1 decimal place.
